en.title: United States stalls Spanish investigation into Alejandro Betancourt, its new oil czar in Venezuela

en.title: Social Democrats win in Sweden and left-wing bloc narrowly prevails, with 94% counted
en.summary: Swedish social democrats have won the election with the left-wing coalition projected to secure 175 seats against the right's 174 seats, while the far-right party loses ground to conservative competitors.

stories.title: Los socialdemócratas ganan con un igualado escenario con mínima ventaja para el bloque de izquierdas

en.title: Social Democrats win with tight scenario with minimal advantage for left-wing bloc
en.summary: Sweden's Social Democrats received the most votes in closely contested elections, with the left-wing bloc holding a narrow one-seat advantage over the right-wing bloc. The results suggest Swedish voters support left-wing parties aligned with NATO, restrictive immigration policies, and prioritizing security against foreign criminal gangs.

stories.title: Heridos varios narcos tras chocar su embarcación con una patrullera de la Guardia Civil en Adra

en.title: Several drug traffickers injured after their vessel collides with Civil Guard patrol boat in Adra
en.summary: A drug smuggling boat collided with a Civil Guard maritime patrol vessel off the coast of Adra in Almería, resulting in five arrests and multiple injuries among the smugglers. The Civil Guard officers remained unharmed in the violent encounter.

en.title: Five arrested and several injured when drug smuggling boat rams patrol vessel in Almería
